title: Check temperature of a specific sensor chip
summary: If you know the name of a specific sensor chip (like coretemp-isa-0000), you can query just that chip to see its readings.

steps.explain: First, run sensors without arguments to see the list of available chip names.
steps.expect: A list of sensor chips, e.g., 'coretemp-isa-0000'.

steps.explain: Run sensors with the specific chip name to see only its readings.

placeholders.name: CHIP_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the sensor chip, e.g., coretemp-isa-0000

steps.expect: Temperature readings for only the specified chip.
